functional_correctness.description: Evaluates whether the code produces the correct output according to the specified requirements and handles edge cases effectively.

accepted_values.3: Correct output for all cases including edge cases

bug_sensitivity.description: Assesses the code's ability to avoid introducing bugs, especially those that stem from subtle errors in logic or handling of edge cases.

accepted_values.1: Some bugs present, but major functionality intact
accepted_values.2: No significant bugs identified but minor issues exist

engineering_quality.description: Measures the overall quality of the code, including clarity, structure, and adherence to best practices.

accepted_values.0: Poor quality, difficult to read and maintain
accepted_values.2: Good quality, generally readable and maintainable
accepted_values.3: Excellent quality, very clear and maintainable

efficiency.description: Evaluates the performance of the code, particularly its time and space complexity relative to the task requirements.

accepted_values.2: Good efficiency, performs well within constraints

robustness.description: Assesses the code's ability to handle unexpected inputs or situations without failing.

accepted_values.0: Crashes or fails with unexpected inputs
accepted_values.1: Handles some unexpected inputs, but not all
accepted_values.3: Robust, handles all unexpected inputs without issues

api_library_usage.description: Evaluates how effectively and appropriately APIs or libraries are used in the implementation.

accepted_values.0: Misuses APIs/libraries or does not utilize relevant ones
accepted_values.1: Uses APIs/libraries, but with some inefficiencies
accepted_values.2: Appropriately uses APIs/libraries with minor inefficiencies
accepted_values.3: Optimally uses APIs/libraries with a thorough understanding

readability_maintainability.description: Measures how easy it is to read, understand, and maintain the code over time.

accepted_values.0: Difficult to read and understand, high maintenance burden
accepted_values.1: Somewhat readable, but has maintainability issues
accepted_values.2: Readable and maintainable, with minor issues
accepted_values.3: Very readable, well-structured, and easy to maintain

error_handling_security.description: Assesses the effectiveness of error handling and the code's resilience against common security vulnerabilities.

accepted_values.0: No error handling or security measures implemented
accepted_values.1: Basic error handling present, some security flaws
accepted_values.2: Good error handling with minimal security issues
accepted_values.3: Excellent error handling and security measures in place
